",["$r","p",null,{"children":["较新的 Stage 3 已在 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc/portage/binrepos.conf/"}]," 中预配置官方 binhost。所以只需要编辑 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"[gentoo]"}]," 配置中的镜像地址；若没有 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"[gentoo]"}]," 配置，则新增它。"]}],"

",["$r","p",null,{"children":"Gentoo Binhost 项目目前支持使用 GNU 工具链（glibc、GCC 和 binutils）的 amd64 和 arm64。其他架构和工具链也会发布二进制包，但仅限 Release Engineering 构建 Stage 3 所用的包缓存。"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":[["$r","code",null,{"children":"sync-uri"}]," 指向包含 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"Packages"}]," 文件的目录。上方配置使用常规 amd64 的 x86-64 二进制包；常规 arm64 系统可将其改为 ",["$r","CodeInline",null,{"codeLanguage":true,"templateId":"template-2"}],"。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["对于常规 amd64 系统，官方建议 CPU 支持 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://www.gentoo.org/news/2024/02/04/x86-64-v3.html","rel":"nofollow","children":"x86-64-v3"}]," 时使用对应的二进制包，以获得针对该指令集的优化。检查 CPU 是否支持："]}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-3","codeLanguage":"bash"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["输出中包含 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"x86-64-v3 (supported, searched)"}]," 即表示支持。可将配置改为："]}],"

",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-5","filepath":"/etc/portage/make.conf","enableQuickSetup":true,"append":true}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":"如果没有合适的二进制包，Portage 会照常从源码编译。"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":"单次使用二进制包安装："}],"
",["$r","CodeBlock",null,{"menus":[],"templateId":"template-6","codeLanguage":"bash"}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["根据 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://www.gentoo.org/support/news-items/2026-05-03-portage-binpkg-changes.html","rel":"nofollow","children":"Portage binpkg changes"}],"，新版 Portage 默认验证远程二进制包的签名，并将其缓存到 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"location"}]," 指定的目录。官方 binhost 用户不再需要启用 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"FEATURES="binpkg-request-signature""}],"；首次下载时，Portage 会自动运行 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"getuto"}]," 创建可信密钥环。"]}],"
",["$r","p",null,{"children":["参考 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://wiki.gentoo.org/wiki/Gentoo_Binary_Host_Quickstart","rel":"nofollow","children":"Gentoo Binary Host Quickstart"}],"，高级配置参考 ",["$r","a",null,{"href":"https://wiki.gentoo.org/wiki/Binary_package_guide","rel":"nofollow","children":"Binary package guide"}],"。"]}],"

",["$r","p",null,{"children":["Bootstrap 成功后，若对 Gentoo Portage 和 Distfiles 换源，可参照以上几节，只需将 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"/etc"}]," 换成 ",["$r","code",null,{"children":"$EPREFIX/etc"}],"。"]}]]}]
